svg.title: crDesk 1.0.0 released
svg.desc: A crDesk release poster with the original app icon, two linked desktops representing remote control, file transfer, clipboard sharing and trusted device access, and nine libcr family app icons.

svg.title: crDesk — Remote Control
svg.desc: A large blue desktop outline with a transparent screen, three diagonal reflection strokes, and a remote cursor filled with a smooth red, yellow and green gradient.

svg.text: THE libcr FAMILY BUILT WITH C++ and chromium

svg.title: crScrcpy application icon
svg.desc: A futuristic rounded-square icon with a Chrome-inspired red, yellow and green gradient border and a blue Android robot.

svg.title: crShare application icon
svg.desc: A futuristic rounded-square icon with a Chrome-inspired red, yellow and green gradient border and a blue share symbol.

svg.title: crRequest application icon
svg.desc: A futuristic rounded-square icon with a Chrome-inspired red, yellow and green gradient border and a blue letter R.

svg.title: crPhotos logo
svg.desc: A four-blade camera aperture using Chrome colors, separated by rotationally symmetric cubic Bezier curves.

svg.title: Player icon
svg.desc: Three seamless curved regions with rich red, gold and blue gradients surround a white play triangle.

svg.title: crYGet
svg.desc: Chrome red, yellow and green regions divided by white cubic Bezier curves of uniform 3px width extending from the play triangle corners, with the original download badge.
